label: Diagram 13
caption: Diagram 13 The separation of combustible material from a factory-made metal chimney designated to BS EN 1856-1:2003
description:
The drawing is titled "Diagram 13 The separation of combustible material from a factory-made metal chimney designated to BS EN 1856-1:2003". It comprises two linked illustrations. On the left, a three-dimensional perspective view shows a vertical metal chimney pipe passing through a framed structure of timber members. A cylindrical sleeve surrounds the pipe within the opening; a leader line labels this "Non-combustible plate with spacer, e.g. manufacturer's fire stop component".

On the right, a circular inset gives a plan view of the same location. Leader lines at the top identify "Plasterboard" as the inner facing and "Timber" as the hatched rectangular stud. A double-walled circle represents the chimney, encircled by a shaded ring. Two dimension arrows, each marked "xx", span the gap between the chimney and the surrounding structure, one vertical at the top and one horizontal at the right. A separate leader from the right edge points to the horizontal dimension and is labelled "Distance xx".

Beneath the inset, a text block reads: "No combustible material in shaded zone. Width of shaded zone at least equal to manufacturer's declared minimum distance (xxmm) as designated to BS EN 1856-1".
